purpose: second unseen test of the current rules with the proposed singular-order extension (VERIF_POSTHOC_SINGULAR=1), in a new singularity class (crack); written after the L-shape result, whose lesson (a displacement may approach its rate from below) is used below
adapter_description: Edge-cracked panel: domain [0,2]x[-1,1], traction-free edge crack along y = 0 from x = 0 to the tip at (1,0); plane strain, small-strain linear elasticity, E = 1000, nu = 0.3. Bottom edge y = -1 clamped; top edge y = 1 loaded by a uniform traction t_y = 1 (mode-I opening); other edges and crack faces free. Crack tip lam = 0.5; clamped/free corners (0,-1), (2,-1) lam = 0.7112. Q2 (9-node) elements, n x n per unit square (n = 2, 4, ..., 128, h = 1/n), separate nodes on the crack faces; strategies at n = 16: coordinates graded toward x = 1 and y = 0 with g = 1.5, 2.0. QoIs: strain_energy = 1/2 u.K u; u_cod_mouth = crack opening u_y(upper) - u_y(lower) at (0,0); v_top_right = u_y at (2,1); tip_gk_avg_von_mises = von Mises with weight exp(-(d/0.1)^2), d the distance to the tip; tip_disc_avg_von_mises = mean over d < 0.2; far_gk_avg_syy = sigma_yy with exp(-(d/0.1)^2) about (1.5,0.5); peak_von_mises = max von Mises over all Gauss points.

theory.note: Q2, lam = 0.5 < 2: the crack tip limits every rate to 2 lam = 1.0 (pollution); the clamped/free corners (lam 0.711) are weaker

stated_in_advance.without the post hoc option: every singular_order check is INCONCLUSIVE (theory implemented for degree-1 elements only)
stated_in_advance.pre-asymptotic label: NOT expected to trigger: the tip is loaded directly in mode I (strong singular coefficient)

developer_expectations.strain_energy: singular_order PASS (order 2 lam = 1.0 within 0.15); convergence PASS with rate
developer_expectations.u_cod_mouth: singular_order PASS (order >= 0.85); convergence PASS with rate
developer_expectations.v_top_right: singular_order PASS (order >= 0.85); LOW confidence: a displacement at a domain corner approached its rate from below on the L-shape
developer_expectations.far_gk_avg_syy: singular_order PASS (order >= 0.85); convergence PASS with rate
developer_expectations.tip_gk_avg_von_mises: convergence PASS; singular_order PASS (order >= 0.85), LOW confidence (nonlinear in the stress, weight centred on the singular point)
developer_expectations.tip_disc_avg_von_mises: convergence PASS (band or rate); singular_order not predicted
developer_expectations.peak_von_mises: convergence FAIL (grows); log-log slope lam - 1 = -0.5 within 0.15 (singular_order PASS); located within 0.1 of the tip (1, 0) on the finest three levels
